statements.status_notes: github.com/klauspost/compress 1.19.2 is embedded in /usr/local/bin/docker-agent from the upstream docker-agent release binary installed by sbx-templates docker-agent kits. The fix requires klauspost/compress 1.20.2 or later; no upstream docker-agent release has shipped with that module bump yet, so remediation depends on a new upstream docker-agent release rebuilt with the updated module.

github.com/klauspost/compress 1.19.2 is embedded in /usr/local/bin/docker-agent from the upstream docker-agent release binary installed by sbx-templates docker-agent kits. The fix requires klauspost/compress 1.20.2 or later; no upstream docker-agent release has shipped with that module bump yet, so remediation depends on a new upstream docker-agent release rebuilt with the updated module.

temporalio-admin-tools 1.28.x and 1.29.x embed klauspost/compress via published dhi/temporalio-server artifacts. debian-13 runtime packages are HSP-based, but these Go binaries still come from the server OCI artifact digests. The temporalio-server definition already bumps compress to 1.18.7; clearing this finding requires republished server images and a digest track update. From 1.30 onward admin-tools builds these binaries from source with golang-1.26 HSP packages and compress 1.18.7.
